question: The music of traditional _______ consists of thumri and other lyrical song forms.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The music of traditional **Kathak** consists of thumri and other lyrical song forms.
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• It traces its origins to the nomadic bards of ancient northern India, known as **Kathakars** or storytellers.
 
• The name **Kathak** is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Katha' meaning story, and 'Kathakar' meaning the one who tells a story.
 
• Traditional Kathak dance often includes music that is rich in thumri, which is a semi-classical vocal form of North India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** dance form has three main gharanas (schools) - Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras.
 
• Each gharana has its own unique features and emphasis on different aspects of the dance form.
 
• The Lucknow gharana, for instance, places a strong emphasis on the expressiveness of the dance, while the Jaipur gharana is known for its intricate footwork.
 
• The dance form has evolved over time and has been influenced by both Hindu and Muslim cultures, especially during the Mughal era.
 
• Kathak performances often include stories from Indian epics like Mahabharata and Ramayana.
